questions.question: Dr. Imad, a young dentist, discovers that an AI software he uses to diagnose cavities has a 15% error rate on certain types of patients. According to the principle of non-maleficence, what is his obligation?
options: Continue using the software because it is fast
Inform patients of the error rate and offer additional examinations
Ignore the problem because 85% reliability is acceptable
Use only AI without clinical examination
questions.explanation: The principle of non-maleficence (do no harm) obliges the dentist to inform patients of the limits of technology and to ensure care in accordance with established scientific knowledge, as provided for in Article 24 of the Code of Ethics.

questions.question: Dr. Soundous is approached by a prosthetic laboratory offering financial benefits in exchange for exclusive prescriptions. According to Article 16 of the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: He can accept because it is a legitimate partnership
He must refuse because any commission is prohibited
He can accept if the prosthetics are of good quality
He must inform the Order before accepting
questions.explanation: Article 16 prohibits any payment, acceptance, or sharing of money between practitioners or with third parties. Commissions and kickbacks are formally prohibited.

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who refuses a treatment he considers necessary for religious reasons. According to the principle of patient autonomy, how should he react?
options: Impose the treatment because it is medically indicated
Respect the patient's refusal and offer alternatives
Refuse to treat the patient
Contact the patient's family to convince them
questions.explanation: The principle of autonomy requires respecting the patient's decision, even if it goes against medical advice, within the limits of the law. The dentist must inform the patient of the consequences of their refusal.

questions.question: Dr. Soundous publishes a spectacular 'before/after' of a treatment on Instagram without the explicit consent of his patient. According to Article 4 of the Code of Ethics, what offense has been committed?
options: A minor professional fault
A violation of professional confidentiality
Authorized advertising
A continuing education act
questions.explanation: Article 4 requires the dentist to ensure the protection against any indiscretion of documents concerning patients, including photographs. Publication without consent is a violation of professional confidentiality.

questions.question: Dr. Imad, faced with profitability pressure from his employer, is invited to multiply unnecessary procedures. According to ethical principles, what is the right attitude?
options: Follow the employer's instructions
Refuse to perform medically unjustified procedures
Perform the procedures to satisfy the employer
Resign immediately
questions.explanation: The dentist has a duty of beneficence towards patients. He must refuse any procedure that is not medically justified, even under economic pressure.

questions.question: According to Article 2 of the Code of Ethics, what is Dr. Soundous's main mission towards the human person?
options: Maximize his income
Respect the life of the human person
Develop his clientele
Promote new technologies
questions.explanation: Article 2 states that the dental surgeon exercises their mission with respect for the life of the human person.

questions.question: Dr. Imad is solicited to participate in an advertising campaign for a toothpaste brand. According to Article 11 of the Code of Ethics, what is the rule?
options: Advertising is permitted with the Order's approval
Advertising is strictly prohibited
Advertising is permitted for hygiene products
Advertising is permitted if it is scientific
questions.explanation: Article 11 prohibits all direct or indirect advertising or publicity methods, including for products.

questions.question: Dr. Soundous discovers that his colleague has prescribed an inappropriate treatment for a patient. According to Article 42 of the Code of Ethics, what is the procedure to follow?
options: Immediately inform the patient
Confidentially notify his disagreement to his colleague
Modify the treatment without warning
Ignore the situation
questions.explanation: Article 42 requires the dentist, if they disagree with a colleague, to inform them confidentially and collegially, without interfering in the treatment.

questions.question: Dr. Imad is confronted with a patient who asks for a complaisance certificate for his employer. According to Article 9 of the Code of Ethics, what is the rule?
options: He may issue the certificate if the patient requests it
It is forbidden to issue a complaisance certificate
He may issue a certificate with the Order's approval
He may issue a partial certificate
questions.explanation: Article 9 prohibits establishing a biased report or issuing a complaisance certificate. The dentist must only issue certificates that conform to the truth.

questions.question: According to Article 7 of the Code of Ethics, must Dr. Soundous treat a patient who has different political opinions from his own?
options: Yes, with the same conscience as other patients
No, he may refuse to treat them
Yes, but only if he agrees
No, political opinions justify a refusal of care
questions.explanation: Article 7 requires the dentist to treat all patients with the same conscience, regardless of their condition, nationality, religion, reputation, and the feelings they inspire.

questions.question: Dr. Imad promised a patient a perfect aesthetic result, without being able to guarantee it. According to Article 20 of the Code of Ethics, what offense has been committed?
options: None, the promise is part of the commercial relationship
A reprehensible imprudence and deception about results
Authorized advertising
A continuing education act
questions.explanation: Article 20 prohibits deceiving the good faith of practitioners or patients by presenting as salutary and safe a procedure that is insufficiently tested. Promising a perfect result is reprehensible imprudence.

questions.question: Dr. Soundous wishes to associate with a colleague. According to Article 59 of the Code of Ethics, what is the prerequisite condition?
options: A verbal agreement between the associates
A written contract respecting each person's professional independence
A simple declaration to the council of the order
An agreement with the owner of the premises
questions.explanation: Article 59 stipulates that there can be no joint practice of the profession without a written contract that must respect the professional independence of each dental surgeon.

questions.question: Dr. Imad is asked to replace a colleague. According to Article 63 of the Code of Ethics, what are his obligations?
options: Sign the treatment forms in the colleague's name
Personally sign the treatment forms
Use the colleague's stamp
Not sign the treatment forms
questions.explanation: Article 63 provides that the replacement dentist must personally sign the health insurance forms of the patients they treat.

questions.question: Dr. Soundous is invited to a congress by a laboratory that covers all his expenses. According to Article 16 of the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: He can accept because it is continuing education
He must refuse because any form of commission is prohibited
He can accept if the content is scientific
He can accept if he declares the expenses
questions.explanation: Article 16 prohibits any payment, acceptance, or sharing of money between practitioners and third parties. Accepting benefits from a laboratory may be considered an ethical violation.

questions.question: According to Article 6 of the Code of Ethics, can Dr. Imad impose a particular payment method on his patient?
options: Yes, he is free to set payment conditions
No, no particular payment method may be imposed on the patient
Yes, if the patient agrees
Yes, for expensive treatments
questions.explanation: Article 6 provides that no particular payment method may be imposed on the patient, thus respecting the patient's freedom in choosing the payment method.

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who asks to be treated outside the practice, at home. According to the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: He can do it if the patient asks
He must respect the principles of the art and safety rules
He cannot refuse the patient
He must seek the Order's approval
questions.explanation: The dentist may practice outside the practice, but must respect safety and hygiene rules, and act in accordance with ethical principles.

questions.question: Dr. Imad is consulted by a patient who is already being treated by a colleague. According to Article 53 of the Code of Ethics, what is his first step?
options: Accept the patient immediately
Propose a joint consultation with the first practitioner
Take over the patient without informing the colleague
Refuse the patient
questions.explanation: Article 53 provides that the second practitioner must first propose a joint consultation before examining the patient.

questions.question: According to Article 30 of the Code of Ethics, must Dr. Soundous provide an estimate for an expensive treatment?
options: No, patients must accept fees without discussion
Yes, he must prepare a written estimate
Yes, but only if the patient requests it
No, an oral estimate is sufficient
questions.explanation: Article 30 requires the dentist to provide a written estimate when proposing a treatment of high cost.

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who asks for information about a colleague. According to Article 50 of the Code of Ethics, what is the rule?
options: He may give his opinion on the colleague
He must refrain from slandering or defaming the colleague
He may give his opinion if the patient insists
He must give his opinion to help the patient
questions.explanation: Article 50 prohibits slandering a colleague, speaking ill of them, or repeating remarks likely to harm them.

questions.question: Dr. Soundous has a patient who refuses the proposed treatment and wishes a second opinion. According to Article 55 of the Code of Ethics, what is the right attitude?
options: Refuse the second opinion
Accept and facilitate consultation with a colleague
Impose his treatment
Abandon the patient
questions.explanation: Article 55 provides that the dental surgeon must in principle agree to meet in consultation with any other dental surgeon or doctor when this consultation is requested by the patient or their family.

questions.question: According to Article 22 of the Code of Ethics, can Dr. Imad, elected as a municipal councilor, use this position to increase his clientele?
options: Yes, it is a legitimate advantage
No, it is prohibited
Yes, if his patients ask him to
Yes, if he mentions his position on his signs
questions.explanation: Article 22 prohibits the dental surgeon who holds an elective mandate or administrative function from using it to increase their clientele.

questions.question: Dr. Soundous is confronted with a patient who insists on a treatment he considers inappropriate. According to Article 24 of the Code of Ethics, what is the rule?
options: He must follow the patient's wishes
He may refuse to perform a treatment he considers inconsistent with scientific data
He must perform the treatment to satisfy the patient
He must seek the Order's opinion
questions.explanation: Article 24 requires the dentist to provide informed care in accordance with established scientific knowledge. He may refuse to perform a treatment that does not respect these principles.

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who asks him not to record certain information in his medical record. According to the Code of Ethics, what is the situation?
options: He may accept the patient's request
He must record all necessary information, in accordance with his obligations
He may record the information separately
He may promise not to record it
questions.explanation: The dentist has an obligation to keep a complete and accurate medical record. He cannot omit important information under patient pressure.

questions.question: According to Article 21 of the Code of Ethics, can Dr. Soundous practice another profession to increase his income through his prescriptions?
options: Yes, it is permitted
No, it is prohibited because it could compromise his independence
Yes, with the Order's approval
Yes, if it does not harm his patient base
questions.explanation: Article 21 prohibits the dental surgeon from practicing any other profession or occupation likely to enable them to increase their income through their prescriptions or professional advice.

questions.question: Dr. Imad has a patient who wishes an aesthetic treatment when conservative treatment would be more appropriate. According to the principles of beneficence, what is the right attitude?
options: Perform the aesthetic treatment to satisfy the patient
Explain to the patient the advantages of conservative treatment and respect their final choice
Refuse to treat the patient
Perform both treatments
questions.explanation: The principle of beneficence requires informing the patient of the different options and their advantages, while respecting their autonomy.
